verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents first-party webhooks. You configure a URL, and when something changes, such as a flag update, LaunchDarkly sends an HTTP POST payload to it, so you can build integrations that subscribe to changes. This is a registrable outbound callback that a programmatic consumer can receive. missing for 10: documented event filtering/subscription scoping, payload signing and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: When something changes, like when a feature flag is updated... LaunchDarkly sends an HTTP POST payload to the webhook's configured URL.
LaunchDarkly’s webhooks allow you to build your own integrations that subscribe to changes in LaunchDarkly.
